title: Build a Bamboo Balance Bike: Our Free Step-by-Step Video Series
body_html:
Editor's note (internal): This Schools post duplicates the News post
"New Balance Bike Tutorial Videos",
which is the canonical version. Both cover the same real four-part YouTube series. This copy has
been rewritten to verified facts only. Consider redirecting to the canonical post or keeping this
as an education-audience landing page that links to it.

The idea

We believe learning to build a bamboo bicycle should be open to anyone, anywhere. So we put our balance bike build online, free to watch, on our YouTube channel — a complete walkthrough that takes you from raw bamboo to a finished frame a young child can ride.

What we did

In November 2024 we published a four-part "How to Build a Bamboo Balance Bike" series on our official YouTube channel. It follows the real Bamboo Bicycle Club home-build method, one stage at a time, so you can build along at your own pace:

1. Part 1 — Cutting the Frame 2. Rear Triangle and Dropouts 3. Part 3 — Gluing the Frame with Epoxy 4. Part 4 — Finishing

The whole series is free and globally accessible — no login, no fee, no specialist workshop required to follow along.

Verified outcome

  • A genuine, complete four-part build series, published 15 November 2024 on our official channel.
  • Free, open-access education in bamboo frame-building for anyone with an internet connection.
  • Part of how Bamboo Bicycle Club shares its method openly: we have trained **4,000+ people across

36+ countries since 2012**.

In our words

"The whole goal of Bamboo Bicycle Club is to make bike-building accessible to everyone."
— James Marr

Why it matters

A balance bike is the simplest frame we teach — which makes it the perfect way to learn the craft. Putting the full build online for free means a teacher, a parent, or a young maker anywhere in the world can follow the same steps we use in our workshops, and finish with a real, ridable bamboo bike.

Watch and build

  • Series playlist and all four parts: our YouTube channel
  • Balance bike build kits and components: bamboobicycleclub.org
  • Canonical announcement: New Balance Bike Tutorial Videos
